items.text: Vercel added one-command configuration connecting eight coding-agent tools to AI Gateway, which offers over 300 models from 30 providers without markup.
items.text_zh: Vercel 新增一条命令即可将八款编程智能体工具接入 AI Gateway，后者提供逾 300 个模型且不加价。

items.text: Character.AI introduced private Lorebooks that remain hidden from profiles and search while supplying private context for character conversations.
items.text_zh: Character.AI 推出私密知识设定集，可为角色对话提供私有背景信息，同时不会出现在个人主页和搜索结果中。

items.text: MiniMax opened Music 3 for local ComfyUI use, describing it as an open-weights music-generation model, with cloud availability planned.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 开放 Music 3 在本地 ComfyUI 中使用，称其为开放权重音乐生成模型，云端版本也将随后上线。

items.text: Replicate added Grok Imagine Image 2.0, highlighting improved text rendering and precise image-editing capabilities.
items.text_zh: Replicate 上线 Grok Imagine Image 2.0，重点支持更清晰的文字生成和更精准的图像编辑。

items.text: Cursor acquired the Firetiger team to develop coding agents that follow software into production and address resulting failures.
items.text_zh: Cursor 收购 Firetiger 团队，以开发能够持续跟进软件生产环境并处理运行故障的编程智能体。

items.text: Cursor said prebuilt environments now make its cloud agents start three times faster while improving resilience and debugging.
items.text_zh: Cursor 表示，预构建环境让云端智能体的启动速度提升至三倍，同时增强了稳定性和调试能力。

items.text: Perplexity improved Search as Code execution reliability from 84% to 98% through SDK changes and reported lower token use in Computer.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 通过调整 SDK 将 Search as Code 的执行可靠率从 84% 提升至 98%，并降低了 Computer 的令牌消耗。

items.text: HeyGen integrated Cartesia voice agents natively into LiveAvatar, allowing existing conversational agents to interact through real-time avatars.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 将 Cartesia 语音智能体原生接入 LiveAvatar，使现有对话智能体能够通过实时数字人进行互动。

items.text: Figma added in-app agent skills that users can create, publish to Community, save and run without leaving the design workspace.
items.text_zh: Figma 新增应用内智能体技能，用户无需离开设计工作区即可创建、发布到社区、收藏和运行技能。

items.text: DeepSeek released Harness v0.1 in developer preview and open-sourced its code for developers building agent-execution environments.
items.text_zh: DeepSeek 发布 Harness v0.1 开发者预览版并开放源代码，面向构建智能体执行环境的开发者。

items.text: AWS introduced an AgentCore browser tool for automating legacy web applications whose interfaces lack APIs or modern integration points.
items.text_zh: AWS 推出 AgentCore 浏览器工具，可自动操作缺少 API 或现代集成接口的传统网页应用。

items.text: VS Code added /btw side chats that share an agent session’s context while letting developers ask questions without interrupting its primary workflow.
items.text_zh: VS Code 新增 /btw 侧边对话，可共享智能体会话上下文，让开发者提问时无需打断主要工作流程。

items.text: Bolt launched multilingual voice dictation that cleans spoken input and turns loosely expressed ideas into context for building applications.
items.text_zh: Bolt 上线多语言语音输入，可整理口述内容，并将尚未成形的想法转化为构建应用所需的上下文。

items.text: Nvidia made more than 300 skills spanning over 30 products available for Cursor’s coding agents.
items.text_zh: 英伟达向 Cursor 编程智能体开放了覆盖 30 多款产品的 300 多项技能。
